technical_and_design_decisions: Upgrade Lattice client dependencies, deployment manifests, and integration code to target Lattice version 0.6.0.
Perform global rename and refactoring of legacy 'Spring XD' to 'Spring Cloud Data Flow' and 'Job(s)' to 'Task(s)' across UI, Shell commands, REST APIs, configurations, and documentation.
Standardize Admin UI and Flo graph component CSS/theming to ensure unified visual styling, color palette, and component layouts.
Extend Admin UI's backend metadata endpoint and UI 'About' dialog to expose application version and active SPI provider type (e.g., Lattice, Local).
Extend Data Flow Shell with dedicated module instance scaling CLI commands ('module scale') that delegate to the underlying SPI scaling abstractions.
assumptions: A single full-stack Java/Angular developer will perform all design, implementation, documentation, and testing work.
The targeted target SPI interface already supports module scaling operations, requiring only Shell and REST API exposure.
Build tools and CI/CD pipelines use standard Maven/Gradle setups configured for Java 17+ compatibility.

activities.activity_description: Review existing system architecture, identify current limitations and gaps between legacy Spring XD concepts and Spring Cloud Data Flow requirements, and document technical design updates.
Upgrade project build configurations, client libraries, and deployment scripts to version 0.6.0 of Lattice, ensuring compatibility with runtime components.
Refactor all user-facing strings, shell command aliases, API endpoints, code references, and documentation from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Data Flow and from Job(s) to Task(s).

activities.activity_name: Admin UI & Flo UI Integration & Enhancements (U4, U5)
activities.activity_description: Align styling between Admin UI and Flo graphs for consistent look and feel. Implement version display and SPI provider type detection in the Admin UI 'About' section.
Add new CLI commands in the Data Flow Shell to directly scale module instances up or down without requiring external SPI CLI tools.
Generate Flo graph visual diagrams/screenshots and embed them into the Batch DSL documentation to illustrate batch data flow concepts clearly.
Perform unit testing, shell command integration tests, UI regression tests, and manual validation of scaling and lattice deployment flows.
